## Problem and resulting behaviour

Describe the user-visible problem, what changes, and why this approach fits the existing design. Link a related issue if there is one.

## Verification

List the commands run and actual results. Separate offline tests, static checks, optional live-provider tests, disposable-media checks and packaged-application checks. Identify skipped checks and remaining limitations.

## Review notes

Mention any changes to tag representation, write safety, dependencies or licences. For a format change, include the authoritative reference and raw-representation evidence. Attach only generated or sanitised examples.

- [ ] I reviewed the diff and new files for unrelated changes, private music, personal data and credentials.
- [ ] I added or updated focused tests for changed behaviour, or explained why they are unnecessary.
- [ ] I updated relevant user or contributor documentation.
- [ ] I have permission to contribute the submitted code and assets under their stated licences.
